data.subject: Dublin expansion and Whatnot's close
data.body:
Hi Kristin,

Whatnot opened a European headquarters on Sir Rogerson's Quay in Dublin and plans to hire 130 people. A few months into the CFO seat, standing up an overseas hub usually introduces multi-currency transactions and an additional entity close. Instacart cut AP approval time from 2 weeks to 2 days with Zamp.

Are you open to a 20-minute call next week?

[Your name]
